target_claim: For degree reverse lexicographic order, if i<j and a_i>a_j, swapping the exponents a_i and a_j produces a monomial larger than the original leading monomial.
source_quote: must also appear in $p$, and if $a_i > a_j$ then it would be larger than $\map {LM} p$, a [[Definition:Contradiction|contradiction]].
